Under section 10 of the Danish Marketing Practices Act, this requires the contact to have asked for it in advance – also when it's a business. It isn't enough that they're not on the Robinson list or marked as advertising-protected in the CVR register.

guide.a: The guide takes you through business, goals, language and knowledge. At each step the AI suggests content based on your website – you adjust and save.

fetch.a: The business page reads your website and fills in description, CVR number, phone and address when they're on the site. Services and opening hours become drafts.

approved.a: The assistant answers only from approved items. Drafts and suggestions are never used until an owner or admin has approved them.

prices.a: Prices are entered excl. VAT. The AI never guesses a price – if a price is on the website, it's quoted in the draft so you can confirm it.

edit.a: Edit an item and save it as a new draft, or delete it. If you delete approved knowledge, the assistant stops using it immediately.

script.a: Decide the greeting, what the assistant asks about, and when a staff member takes over. Applies to both phone and chat.

phone.a: Keep your number and forward it to your Dialogbot number. Choose a voice, test the connection and activate. Calls land under Calls with a transcript.

webchat.a: Turn on the widget, approve your domains and paste the code into your website. You can take over a conversation under Calls.

tasks.a: Customers who want to be contacted become enquiries with a task. Qualify, approve and resolve them from Calls → Open enquiry.

billing.a: There's one subscription from {pMonthly} per month excl. VAT, including 300 minutes for inbound and outbound calls (then {pExtraMinute} per minute in and {pMinute} per minute out). Inside the package there is no charge per call; once it is used, an outbound call costs {pCallAnswered} (answered), {pCallVoicemail} (voicemail) or {pCallNoAnswer} (unanswered) plus {pMinute} per minute. Account shows the month's preview.

roles.a: Owners and admins approve knowledge and change settings. Staff work with enquiries and drafts. Readers can only view.

log.a: All approvals, deletions and settings changes are logged with who and when.
